name: pragmatic-programmer
description: Hunt and Thomas's The Pragmatic Programmer as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for DRY knowledge, orthogonality, tracer bullets, contracts, debugging, automation and owning the result.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short The Pragmatic Programmer rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
